THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of section 7 of theland Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition(Amendment)Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Governmentintends to acquire the following Land which is required for apublic purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

The allotments of land in extent of 0.8413 hectares depictedin the Advance Tracing No. KE/YTY/2017/44 dated19/03/2017 prepared by the Surveyor General, within theboundaries shown below situated in the Village of Ganepallain the Grama Niladari Division of No. 135, Ganepalla in theMinor Division of Kithulgala Palatha of the DivisionalSecretary's Division of Yatiyantota in the District of Kegallein Sabaragamuwa Province.
01. Lot A; Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division);Extent:0.2326 Hectare;Boundaries:
North: Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division); East: GanepallaEstate (Upper Division) and Lot No. B (Road); South: Lot No.B (Road); West: Road and Stream.
02. Lot B; Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division);Extent:0.0703 Hectare;Boundaries:

North: Lot No. A Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division) and LotNo. C; East: Lot No. A, Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division) andLot No. C and E; South: Lot No. C, Ganepalla Estate (UpperDivision), Lot No. E and D; West: Lot No. D and Stream, LotNo. A.
03. Lot C; Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division);Extent:0.1869 Hectare;Boundaries:

North: Lot No. B (Road) and Ganepalla Estate (UpperDivision); East: Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division) and LotNo. B (Road); South: Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division) LotNo. B (Road); West: Lot No. B (Road).
04. Lot D; Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division);Extent:0.2959 Hectare;Boundaries:
North and East: Lot No. B (Road); South:Lot No. B (Road)and Stream; West: Stream.
05. Lot E; Ganepalla Estate (Upper Division);Extent:0.0556 Hectare;Boundaries:
North: Lot No. B (Road); East: Ganepalla Estate (UpperDivision); South: Stream; West: Lot No. B (Road).

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition(Amendment)Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intendsto acquire the following Land which is required for a publicpurpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

The allotments of land in extent of 1.1671 Hectares depictedin the Advance Tracing No. KE/YTY/2016/259 dated29/09/2016 prepared by the Surveyor General, within theboundaries shown below situated in the Village of Wee Oya in
the Minor Division in the Dehigampal Korale of the DivisionalSecretary's Division of Yatiyantota in the District of Kegalle inSabaragamuwa Province.
01. Lot A; Extent:0.0014 Hectare;Boundaries:
North: Trench; East: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha); South: LotNo. B; West: Wee Oya Estate.
02. Lot B; Extent:0.1657 Hectare;Boundaries:
North: Wee Oya Estate and Lot No. A; East: Road(Pradeshiya Sabha); South: Road (Pradeshiya Sabha) and WeeOya Estate; West: Wee Oya Estate.
